study: V2 joint depth-label model comparison (separate from the frozen V1 Stage M; Stage M and C3 decisions unchanged)
status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY V2 COMPARISON FIT

source_package.expansion: Astra's seven-arm design plus two system controls (J_trained, VX_stump), prospectively; Astra's 140/180/200 fit caps are replaced by the caps below

data.population: NEW-136 (124 Keyhole / 12 no Keyhole), canonical any-observed-Keyhole label, all 49 exclusions preserved, full simulation IDs
data.inputs: P, VX, LS radius, ST only (log of each, standardized on the feature-only fold training pool, ddof 0)
data.response: existing ACTIVE A (startup retained, 90 % of derived exit), z = log(A / 111 um); unavailable or nonpositive A is missing (never imputed); a missing response keeps its label and its query
data.paths: exactly the saved Week 19 feature-only maximin prefixes = stage_m/paths.csv NEW rows (verified identical to Week 19, 10/10)
data.paid_interface: src.jdl_stage_m.Oracle reveals only the paid rows (Y, z); the learner never receives unpaid or held-out outcomes
data.reference_pool: the fixed feature-only fold training pool; delta is centred there; test rows are never candidates; the pool is never recentred on the paid subset or the prediction batch
no: held-out monitors or subgroup metadata in training

inference_V2.evidence: EP approximate label evidence including site constants; the identical response evidence cancels between components
inference_V2.fallback: if EP fails in ANY component, EVERY component is refitted by Laplace (accept: finite objective, whitened gradient inf-norm <= 2e-06); a failing fallback marks that checkpoint failed; no component is dropped; tau, delta, tolerances are never changed; no second seed
inference_V2.prediction: mixture of component probit probabilities; within- and between-component covariance retained
inference_V2.known_approximation_errors: preserved as recorded by Astra (scalar EP 0.000583 vs Laplace 0.017007; two-label 0.00338/0.000579/0.000210; V1 sparse negative Laplace 0.674 / EP 0.721 / ESS 0.732) and measured on one real prefix in the validation (EP vs elliptical slice)

arms.rho1_EP: the mixture's rho=1 EP component (exact reuse; same paths/preprocessing/target/priors/EP implementation); a separate fixed-rho=1 EP fit if the mixture fell back to Laplace; a Laplace-fallback rho=1 component is flagged as not an EP control
arms.Binary_V2_EP: new fit, continuous likelihood removed only; one EP solve shared by the three components; masses must equal 1/3; nothing learned from depth
arms.V1_Laplace: exact reuse of Stage M J predictions after verifying path prefix hash, scaler, config, use_response and implementation hash
arms.Binary_V1_Laplace: exact reuse of Stage M Binary_matched predictions (same verification)
arms.ACTIVE_E1: exact reuse of Stage M ACTIVE_E1 predictions (frozen implementation, prefix hash verified)
arms.G3: exact reuse of Stage M G3 predictions (frozen implementation, prefix hash verified)
arms.J_trained: new fit with EX2's trained_config exactly (sklearn ML-II on paid responses only: amplitude in [0.032, 10], four lengthscales in [0.05, 20], noise fixed 0.03, zero mean, 0 restarts); theta, delta, tau priors unchanged. A complete-system control, not a capacity-matched attribution control
arms.VX_stump: new fit, vx-stump-1.0: cut and orientation learned from the paid labels on standardized log VX (rule in src/jdl_vx_stump.py); class-weighted smoothed leaf scores are not population-calibrated probabilities

endpoints.primary: NEW B40 BA at cutoff 0.5 (pooled per repeat, mean of repeats 1-2), V2_EP_mixture minus Binary_V2_EP, paired by split and budget
mechanism: V2_EP_mixture minus rho1_EP (uncertain sharing vs forced sharing)
metrics: short-K sensitivity (the existing 10 NEW short-K simulations, unique cases)
endpoints.confusion_counts: TP/FN/TN/FP and unique simulations reported with every rate
endpoints.secondary_rule: for probabilistic arms (all except VX_stump) the previously declared paid-prevalence rule p >= pi_hat (share of positives among the checkpoint's paid labels; train-only; no threshold fitted from evaluation labels). A train-only cutoff is a heuristic, not necessarily an unbiased prevalence estimate or a Bayes-optimal rule
endpoints.fast_scan_corner: errors inside VX > 0.85 m/s are reported as evaluation-only description (the cut is used by the evaluator only and never by a model)

uncertainty.bootstrap: class-stratified simulation-cluster resampling (src.jdl_evaluate.boot_weights: 2000 draws, seed 20261013), multiplicities shared by both repeats, both budgets and all arms; conditional on the stored fits and these splits; repeated predictions of a simulation are not additional independent cases

screen.rule: Astra's development screen: V2 is promising for further model work only if NEW B40 mean BA(V2) - BA(Binary_V2) >= +0.01, specificity(V2) >= specificity(Binary_V2) and log loss(V2) <= log loss(Binary_V2). +0.01 is a practical effect threshold, not a forecast or a significance test
screen.always_reported: intervals, case counts, q20 and short-K trade-offs, whether or not the screen passes; no success criterion is added after the results

expectations.identities: Binary_V2_EP masses equal 1/3 exactly; rho1_EP equals the mixture's rho=1 component; no numeric performance forecast (Astra: V2 may withdraw harmful sharing and may lose efficiency where depth is informative)

planned_component_attempts.rho1_EP: 0 if reused (up to 20 if fallbacks force separate fits)

accounting.rule: failures and fallbacks are counted; if a genuine numerical need would exceed the caps, a prospective amendment is written before any further computation

post_fit_export: src/jdl_v2_export.py, added on 2026-10-14 after Astra's decision-acquisition handoff and before this freeze. For V2_EP_mixture, Binary_V2_EP and any separate rho1_EP fit it saves the full component posteriors (weights, log evidences, joint h and f means and covariances, f-h cross-covariances and theta moments over [fold reference pool; test inputs]) to _cache/v2_exports, with SHA-256 sidecars. It changes no fit, prediction, metric or decision of this comparison; it serves the separately manifested cached-posterior decision audit.
threads: one BLAS thread; the four-thread total across all local jobs is respected (the run starts only when a temporal worker thread has freed)
